Evaluate new hardware and software solutions to support technology insertion into next-generation architectures. Knowledge of and experience with real-time operating systems, embedded software architectures, and AUTOSAR. Strong communication skills with the ability to, for a wide variety of audiences, adapt the explanation of complex technical concepts.
